findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "v1" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: kenwea_notary_check, kenwea_notary_check_tools · Private data: kenwea_notary_check, kenwea_notary_verify, kenwea_notary_get_public_key, kenwea_notary_check_tree, kenwea_notary_check_tools · Public sink: kenwea_notary_check · Destructive: kenwea_notary_check, kenwea_notary_verify, kenwea_notary_check_tree, kenwea_notary_check_tools.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: kenwea_notary_check, kenwea_notary_check_tools · Private data: kenwea_notary_check, kenwea_notary_verify, kenwea_notary_get_public_key, kenwea_notary_check_tree, kenwea_notary_check_tools · Public sink: kenwea_notary_check · Destructive: kenwea_notary_check, kenwea_notary_verify, kenwea_notary_check_tree, kenwea_notary_check_tools

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
